newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - JGBs could fall if Nikkei rally continues.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - JGBs could fall if Nikkei rally continues.

text.p: Key June Japanese government bond (JGB) futures are expected to be volatile in Wednesday's Tokyo session.
Traders said the benchmark futures contract could fall further if Tokyo stocks maintain their strength today.
The June fell sharply on Tuesday as the Nikkei 225 stock average surged, closing up 666.19 points at 20,180.92.
"If the Nikkei continues to rise towards 21,000, JGB futures could test lower. If stocks fall, however, we may see some recovery," said a trader at a trust bank's securities unit.

"If the Nikkei remains comfortably above 20,000, that could lead to a more optimistic outlook about the economy. In that case, JGB futures could fall further," said a trader at a city bank's securities unit.
Traders expect supply worries to continue weighing on JGBs.
A number of Japanese firms, including some electric power companies, are expected to launch straight bonds in the near future, traders said.
A firmer yen may provide some support to JGBs, traders said. The dollar was quoted at 125.25/30 yen in early trade on Wednesday, down from 125.83/84 yen in late Tuesday in Tokyo.
